items.name: Morpho assets and prices
items.description: Token prices and asset registry for DeFi: address, symbol, decimals, chain and live USD spot price plus native yield of yield-bearing tokens (wstETH, sUSDe…), for every loan, collateral and vault asset on Morpho. Token price lookup, price feed, asset discovery across Base, Ethereum and every Morpho chain — e.g. GET /assets?symbol=wstETH. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Best yield finder
items.description: Best yield for USDC, ETH or any asset in DeFi lending right now: deposit options across Morpho vaults and markets ranked by net APY with and without rewards, with TVL, available liquidity and fees. Pass the asset symbol and get a ranked, deposit-ready answer in one call — e.g. GET /best-yield?asset=USDC&chainId=8453&minTvlUsd=1000000. Live data from the official Morpho API (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Katana and more). Where to park stablecoins, highest APY, best lending rate, yield comparison, where to deposit idle capital. Check /morpho/markets/:id/risk before depositing. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Liquidation history
items.description: Executed liquidations on DeFi lending markets: timestamp, market, liquidator address, repaid debt, seized collateral and bad debt per event, filterable by chain, market, time range and size. Calibrate liquidation risk models, analyze liquidator competition, quantify realized losses. Liquidation feed, seized collateral data, liquidator leaderboard input. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Morpho lending markets
items.description: DeFi lending markets with live rates: supply APY, borrow APY, net APY including rewards, utilization, LLTV, TVL and available liquidity per market across Base, Ethereum and every Morpho chain. Filter by loan or collateral asset, APY range, utilization or minimum TVL; sort by any rate — e.g. GET /markets?loanAssetSymbol=USDC&supplyApyGte=0.05&orderBy=supplyApy. Data from the official Morpho API. Compare lending yields and borrow costs, screen markets before depositing or borrowing. Drill down with /morpho/markets/:marketId and /morpho/markets/:marketId/risk. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Morpho market snapshot
items.description: One Morpho Blue lending market by id: live supply and borrow APY including rewards, utilization, LLTV, loan and collateral assets, supplied / borrowed / available liquidity in USD. One-call snapshot for yield checks, borrow-cost checks and monitoring — e.g. GET /markets/0x…?chainId=8453. Sister endpoints: /history (rate timeseries), /risk (bad debt and collateral-at-risk), /liquidity (exit capacity). No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Market rate history
items.description: Historical rate timeseries of a DeFi lending market: supply APY, borrow APY, net APY including rewards, utilization and supplied / borrowed / available liquidity in USD as hourly, daily or weekly points over any range — e.g. GET /markets/0x…/history?interval=DAY&start=1735689600. Chart lending rates, backtest yield strategies, detect rate spikes. APY history, interest rate chart, yield backtest data. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Market exit liquidity
items.description: True available liquidity of a DeFi lending market: instantly withdrawable and borrowable assets plus reallocatable shared liquidity from public-allocator vaults, in tokens and USD, with utilization. Know real exit and borrow capacity before moving size — pre-trade check for treasuries and large depositors. Can I withdraw, exit liquidity check, borrow headroom. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Market risk passport
items.description: Risk passport of a DeFi lending market in one call: bad debt (realized and unrealized), risk warnings, oracle address and type, utilization and liquidity, plus a collateral-at-risk ladder showing how much collateral gets liquidated at each price-drop level. Due-diligence before supplying or borrowing; pairs with /morpho/positions/at-risk for live liquidation candidates. Is this market safe, toxic market filter, liquidation cascade risk. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Wallet portfolio on Morpho
items.description: Full DeFi lending portfolio of ANY wallet address (no signup, works for wallets you don't own): vault deposits and borrow positions with USD values, health factor and price-drop distance to liquidation per position, PnL, ROE and margin totals on Morpho. One-call position tracker for portfolio monitoring, risk alerts and copy-trading research. Wallet positions, defi portfolio tracker, borrow health check. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Positions at liquidation risk
items.description: Borrow positions closest to liquidation on Morpho lending markets: health factor, price-drop distance to liquidation, collateral and debt in USD per wallet, sorted most-at-risk first — e.g. GET /positions/at-risk?maxHealthFactor=1.05&chainId=8453. Real-time liquidation-candidate feed for liquidation bots, risk monitors and market-stress dashboards. Liquidation opportunities, underwater positions, health factor scanner. Pairs with /morpho/liquidations (executed history). No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Morpho protocol stats
items.description: DeFi lending protocol macro stats per chain: TVL, total supplied, total borrowed and total collateral in USD, deposit, market, vault and user counts across Base, Ethereum and every Morpho chain. Track protocol growth, capital flows and chain dominance in one call. Protocol TVL, total value locked, lending volume, defi analytics. Source: official Morpho API. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Morpho yield vaults
items.description: DeFi yield vaults (Morpho MetaMorpho) with live APYs: net APY after fees including rewards, TVL, performance fee, curator and underlying asset, across Base, Ethereum and every Morpho chain. Filter by asset symbol (USDC, WETH…), curator, minimum APY or TVL — e.g. GET /vaults?assetSymbol=USDC&netApyGte=0.04. Data from the official Morpho API. Find the best stablecoin or ETH vault for idle capital; verify with /morpho/vaults/:address/history (realized APY) and /governance (safety check) before depositing. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Morpho Vault V2s
items.description: Morpho Vault V2 next-generation yield vaults with live APYs: net APY after performance and management fees including rewards, TVL, instantly withdrawable liquidity in USD, curator and underlying asset. Filter by asset, curator, minimum APY, liquidity or TVL — pick the best V2 vault with real exit liquidity. Data from the official Morpho API. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Morpho vault snapshot
items.description: One Morpho yield vault by address: live APY and net APY after fees including rewards, TVL, performance fee, curator and underlying asset. One-call vault snapshot for yield tracking, deposit decisions and position monitoring. Chain into /history for realized performance and /governance for rug-vector checks. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Vault governance check
items.description: Governance and safety check of a DeFi yield vault: owner, curator, guardian and fee recipient addresses, timelock, pending parameter changes (fee, caps, timelock) and recent admin events. Detect governance risk, rug vectors and unannounced fee hikes before depositing. Is this vault safe, curator check, vault due diligence, rug pull check. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Vault performance history
items.description: Historical performance of a DeFi yield vault: realized APY, net APY, TVL, share price in USD and fee as hourly, daily or weekly points. Verify advertised yields against realized returns before depositing, chart vault performance, backtest allocation strategies. Realized yield, vault track record, APY history. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.

items.name: Whale flow alerts
items.description: Whale alerts for DeFi lending: large supply, withdraw, borrow and repay transactions above a chosen USD threshold, with wallet address, market and transaction hash — e.g. GET /whales?minAssetsUsd=1000000. Early signal of rate moves and liquidity shifts; smart-money tracking for trading and yield agents at a fraction of premium-analytics prices. Whale watching, large deposits, smart money flows. No API key — pay per call with USDC (x402) on Base.
